description: Builds a commented .htaccess file for Apache and LiteSpeed: force HTTPS, www or non-www, 301 redirects, error pages, security headers, caching, compression and IP blocks. Returns the file text and findings.

block_ips.description: IPv4 or IPv6 addresses or CIDR ranges to block.

domain.description: The domain the record is for, such as example.com. Optional.

error_403.description: Path of the 403 page, such as /403.html.

error_404.description: Path of the 404 page, such as /404.html.

error_500.description: Path of the 500 page, such as /500.html.

hotlink_protection.description: Block other sites from embedding images. Needs domain.

protect_files.description: Block access to sensitive files such as .env and .git.

redirects.description: 301 redirects from an old path to a new path or URL.

redirects_are_regex.description: Treat the from values as regular expressions.

www.description: Redirect to the www or the non-www host. Defaults to none.

name: htaccess_generator
title: .htaccess generator
